reviewNotes: Reviewed all 118 exported keys against all 20 cards and explicit furigana in data/pages28-29-science.json. Topic/contrast は, では and には corrected to わ only in reviewed contexts. Directional へ in peptide, sugar, alcohol and acid transformation destinations rendered え. Object を rendered お. Preserved lexical はっこう, はんしょく, はっちょうみそ, はたらき, はたらける, はたらかせる, はんい, こうそはんのう, はやさ and へんか. pH spoken ぴーえいち; loanwords transcribed to hiragana, including ぶどうとう, あみのさん, ぺぷちど, あるこーる, ぽりぐるたみんさん and ぜろ; long vowels retained. Process arrows rendered comma pauses. Explicit technical readings including とうかこうそ, たんぱくしつぶんかいこうそ, にさんかたんそ, さくさんきん, ねんしつぶつ, たいえんせい and こうきせいぶん retained. Display labels and lookup keys unchanged. No listening or pitch-accent verification.
